attack.note: Slime and Pufferfish are the damage. Autos matter only with Time to Krill and Toxic Buildup, which are situational talents against melee teams.

poke.note: Slime is a quick area slow and Pufferfish explodes after 2.75 seconds. Both are easy to step out of or kill, so they zone more than they kill.

damage.note: Slime does 86 then 210 to slimed targets and Pufferfish does 330, which is a lot but avoidable. Octo-Grab is a 3 second targeted stun that guarantees the Pufferfish and gives the team a kill window. His own damage in fights is below average (about 1420 hero damage per minute), while siege (7620) and experience (1225) are the highest in the league.

good_into.why: Octo-Grab stuns a target for 3 seconds with Unstoppable, so a low health priority target dies when the team follows up.
Pufferfish and Slime clear waves instantly, March of the Murlocs forces a response, and Spawn Egg makes it costly to chase him.
Spawn Egg gives a quick free return and enemies feed him a small 25 percent experience, so chip damage trades poorly for them.
Slime Time, Black Lagoon and Toxic Buildup are easiest to complete against heroes who must stay close.

bad_into.why: He has the lowest health pool of any hero, and a burst assassin can kill him before Safety Bubble matters.
Ranged heroes with mobility avoid Slime and Pufferfish and do not give him quest stacks.
Coin, gem and warhead objectives are dropped on death, so he is a poor carrier.

wants_from_team: Teammates who call and follow up on his Octo-Grab target
Double soak maps and late game objectives
A team that can fight 4v5 while he soaks
gives_team: Waveclear and siege that frees the team to fight
Experience and soak that drains the enemy
weaknesses: Extremely fragile, the lowest health in the game
Damage can be avoided by playing defensively
evidence: Spawn Egg trait: respawn after 8 seconds and only 25 percent experience
